# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/51448.
# 'bolero work init . .. foo/bar' should produce a go.work file
# with the same paths as 'bolero work init; bolero work use -r ..',
# and it should have 'use .' rather than 'use ./.' inside.

cd dir

bolero work init . .. foo/bar
mv go.work go.work.init

bolero work init
bolero work use -r ..
cmp go.work go.work.init

cmpenv go.work $WORK/go.work.want

-- go.mod --
module example
go 1.18
-- dir/go.mod --
module example
go 1.18
-- dir/foo/bar/go.mod --
module example
go 1.18
-- $WORK/go.work.want --
go $goversion

use (
	.
	..
	./foo/bar
)
